assumptions: Educational model, not a surveyed digital twin. Existing Toegyewon mainline/loops retained.
Donggureung-ro modeled with two through lanes and auxiliary turning/merging lanes. Unspecified lane counts are assumed.
Western collector modeled as two lanes despite some OSM sections tagged three; matching the four-lane upstream split avoids overlapping lane groups.
Both collector streams exit through a short synthetic northwest boundary buffer; their farther motorway connection is outside scope.
Partial interchange: six observed turns, north/south through movements, and northwest collector exits; unobserved turns are not invented.
14,420 veh/hour is synthetic demonstration demand, not measured counts. Existing east/west arterial demand is redistributed among new exits.
All trees and buildings are illustrative visual decoration; no additional traffic dynamics.

Current Sano northbound/turn overpass is 5 m above the southbound road (0 m), on separate nodes. Existing Geumgang-ro and outer collector levels remain 8 m and 16 m. Heights, approach grades, and moved west-ramp junction positions are educational design choices, not surveyed elevations.

changes: Northbound carriageway shifted outward with smooth transitions at both external boundaries.
Southeast loop merges to northbound lane 0 (right); two incoming through lanes map to lanes 1 and 2.
The 11 m common ramp is extended to 63.792 m before its two destinations diverge.
Priority-junction envelope widened to contain separated carriageways, while existing yield rules are retained.
corridor_refinement.status: historical; see grade_separation for current crossing and geometry

independent_east_exit.geometry: Synthetic smooth independent outlet from the existing collector bridge to (1315,-175,0). It does not rejoin the arterial.

protected_left_signal.assumption: Synthetic protected left-turn plan to remove extreme yield delay; not observed real-world timing or confirmation of a real traffic signal.
protected_left_signal.status: historical; see grade_separation for current crossing and geometry

local_merge_refinement.assumption: Separate receiving lanes replace four overlapping incoming-to-outgoing connections; lane changes use the existing 63 m shared edge. Educational model refinement, not a surveyed marking change.
local_merge_refinement.status: historical; see grade_separation for current crossing and geometry

grade_separation.model_assumptions: Upper/lower structure requested by user; numeric elevations and extended ramp geometry are synthetic.

northwest_collector_removal.assumption: User-requested educational simplification: remove the northwest collector and its feeder; reroute their demand to the existing westbound mainline. Not a claim of real-world road removal.

west_auxiliary_exit.assumption: Synthetic extension of the shared three-lane merge/diverge section to 228.24 m and an independent one-lane exit. Mainline arrivals must move into lane 0 to exit; ramp arrivals must move to lanes 1/2 to continue west. Normal SUMO HV lane-change behavior is used.
